changes.title: Beach bearings
items: Stargazing on the beach, the camera sits further back and lower, framed for each stretch of the coast: the moon's reflection on the water, the beach and the sky
On the east and west coasts the shore now runs up the picture with the sea beside it, instead of only sand

changes.title: Lie of the land
items: The land now has a shape: every runestone stands on a rise and every sleeping legend lies in a hollow, and the woods grow thicker in the low ground and thinner on the heights

changes.title: Combat light
items: The wild forest is darker while you explore
Your light grows slowly when a fight starts near you, and settles back afterwards
